text:
sam: Nimbus wants a 3-week POC: streaming partial claim parsing into their UI + function/tool calls to their extractor. Procurement needs SOC2 answers and a headline reserved-price. Can we assemble a tiny dev runbook + pricing note?

jenna: Stack check: Node frontend (WS/SSE), Python workers, small Go adapter.

miguel: Node SSE example for streaming + function_call + structured JSON:
```js
const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-large-v2',stream:true,structured_output:true,tools:[{name:'claim_extract'}]});
s.on('function_call', async (call)=>{ const res = await fetch('/adapter/extract',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({text:call.args.text})}); await s.resume({tool_result:await res.json()}); });
```
Prefer WS for bidirectional low-latency; SSE is simpler and works with resume flow.

devon: Ops defaults for POC: batch_size=1, max_concurrency=3, token_window=4096, prefix_kv_cache=true. Use 8-bit quantized runtime if latency needs improvement. Set fallback policy to 'smaller-model' to avoid hard failures.

priya: SOC2 checklist: data residency, retention window, KMS/CMEK, subprocessors, and PII handling. If they will send PII recommend Redwood Private (VPC). I can prefill the questionnaire if we get their security contact + example payload (headers ok, redact PII).

elaine: Pricing sketch: 3-week reserved bucket for a small pilot (1-2 qps) ~$6k + overage; offer a one-time POC discount (15-20%) subject to deal-desk. Audit/log retention add-on priced separately.

sam: Can someone turn this into a 1-page handoff we can email Nimbus? Also confirm SSE emits function_call and tool_result events for the UI.

miguel: Confirmed: SSE will stream function_call events. Pattern: stream emits function_call -> adapter invoked -> adapter posts tool_result to /streams/resume -> stream emits structured deltas to client.

jenna: I'll prepare Postman + minimal Node/Python snippets. Miguel -> finalize code; Devon -> ops runbook; Priya -> prefilled security Q; Elaine -> pricing blurb. Tag with #poc-handovers when ready.

redwood-bot: Reminder: add #poc-handovers tag so sales-ops picks up the onboarding tasks.
